identity.name: Familiar
identity.description: Form and maintain a persistent expressive mediator between a caster and their use of Spells.
identity.inherent_ability: Give persistent, recognizable form to a holder's systemic pull so their expression, preferences, history, attention, stake, and characteristic ways of acting can participate coherently across casts.

expressions.name: Summon
expressions.description: Resolve an existing Familiar or draw a provisional candidate from authorized evidence when none is adopted.

expressions.name: Register
expressions.description: Persist a holder-recognized Familiar form and its current expressive contract.

expressions.name: Consult
expressions.description: Let a Familiar contribute its systemic pull to a concrete situation without overriding reality or authority.

expressions.name: Recall
expressions.description: Resolve a registered Familiar and its attributable history for later casting.

required.description: Current evidence identifying who or what the Familiar belongs to and the scope in which it is being summoned.
Current evidence of the holder or authorized commissioner controlling adoption and form replacement.

optional.description: Explicit current preferences attributable to the holder.
Authorized attributable history that can inform expression without being mistaken for current identity.
Current domain, role, project, or environment context relevant to this summoning.
Existing Familiar registration, when one already exists for the holder and scope.

requirements.description: The holder and requested Familiar scope are sufficiently resolved for the effect being attempted.
Material used to form or advise through the Familiar is attributable to an authorized source rather than invented as holder history.

limits.description: After adoption, a Familiar may develop its form but may not autonomously replace that form; replacement requires holder-authorized identity change or reassignment.
An inferred Familiar remains a candidate until the holder recognizes or adopts it; the Spell must not pronounce unsupported identity as fact.
Familiar language and systemic pull may guide attention and expression but cannot manufacture telemetry, authority, evidence, or truth.
A Familiar may influence only scopes where its holder or role has relevant stake and authority.

resources.description: Recognition, correction, stories, examples, and explicit expression supplied by the holder.
Amount and quality of attributable history available for study.
Current project, domain, role, and environment observations available to ground the summoning.
Effort spent comparing candidates, strengths, shadows, language, and systemic pull before adoption.

effect.description: A provisional or registered Familiar representation that can be inspected, recognized, recalled, and used as a bounded participant in later Spell casting.

required.description: Inspectable record of the Familiar effect produced by this cast: candidate, registration, recall, or consultation result with provenance appropriate to the expression.

trials.description: With evidence but no holder recognition, Summon produces a provisional candidate and does not claim adopted identity.
After explicit holder adoption, Register produces inspectable persistent state that Recall can resolve later.
A later model preference cannot replace an adopted Familiar form without holder authorization.
A registered Familiar changes an appropriate later casting through its systemic pull while telemetry and hard limits remain authoritative.
